title.zh: 【法国拟将加密货币资本利得税扩大到包括涉及欧盟监管的稳定币的交易】
title.en: 【法国拟将加密货币资本利得税扩大到包括涉及欧盟监管的稳定币的交易】

current_state.zh: France's 2027 budget proposal would broaden the 31.4% cryptocurrency capital gains tax to cover transactions involving EU-regulated stablecoins, but the finance committee rejected the budget's revenue section, forcing the measure back to a full National Assembly vote set for October 20.
current_state.en: France's 2027 budget proposal would broaden the 31.4% cryptocurrency capital gains tax to cover transactions involving EU-regulated stablecoins, but the finance committee rejected the budget's revenue section, forcing the measure back to a full National Assembly vote set for October 20.
